text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
The day of the spring Tenno Sho has<n>arrived, and
Super Creek is getting<n>wound up by Tamamo
Cross.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Tamamo Cross even threatens to<n>whomp me so
badly that I'll never<n>recover.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Determined to protect me, Super<n>Creek takes on
the race against<n>Tamamo Cross with her heart
ablaze.
